notes: job_watch_batches.json is the definitive source for batch membership.
FULL is assigned only where the official inventory can be exhaustively enumerated or a provider-documented public job feed can represent all published postings.

Structured feed URLs derived from a verified Greenhouse/Ashby/SmartRecruiters board or company identifier are recorded only when the vendor's official documentation states that the endpoint is public and unauthenticated; this session's web URL-safety layer may still prevent raw endpoint opening.
LinkedIn, Glassdoor and aggregators are not completeness sources.

verification.pagination: Workday dynamic paging/load-more; enumerate until the displayed result set is exhausted

job_watch_method.primary: Use the official Workday AccentureCareers inventory; run separate location queries for Milan/Milano, Rome/Roma and London, enumerate every loaded page/result and deduplicate by requisition/job ID.
job_watch_method.fallback: Use Accenture's official job search front-end to discover/confirm roles; use web search only for discovery and never to prove completeness.

limitations: Workday is heavily JavaScript-driven in this environment.
A stable unauthenticated structured feed was not independently validated, so completeness should not be claimed from a single rendered page.

verification.pagination: Avature search pages/filters, but the inventory returned HTTP 406 to this crawler

job_watch_method.primary: Attempt the Deloitte Avature SearchJobs inventory and apply the Italy/location facets for Milan and Rome; only mark the company VERIFIED if the complete result set can actually be enumerated in that run.
job_watch_method.fallback: Use Deloitte Italy official careers/job pages and exact-title web discovery for individual roles; London must be checked on the UK member-firm career inventory separately.

limitations: The Avature inventory returned HTTP 406 to the available crawler, preventing a complete enumeration.
Deloitte career inventories are segmented by member firm/country; the Italy inventory does not prove London coverage.

verification.pagination: Numbered pages with explicit result range and total; enumerate through the last page

job_watch_method.primary: Use EY's official counted view-all SuccessFactors inventory, enumerate every numbered page through the displayed total, then filter the reconciled inventory to Milan/Rome/London and evaluate EY/EY-Parthenon role fit from the official JD.
job_watch_method.fallback: If the view-all inventory changes structure, use the official EY search and current EY/EY-Parthenon job-detail pages; do not claim VERIFIED unless the current inventory total is reconciled.

limitations: Result totals and page counts change continuously; capture them per run.

ats.family: Phenom career front-end (application backend not independently revalidated)

verification.pagination: Dynamic Phenom result pages; offset-style navigation is observable but the complete list is client-rendered

job_watch_method.fallback: Use PwC/Strategy& official job-detail pages for confirmation; London requires the PwC UK inventory separately.

Do not infer a Workday tenant solely from job identifiers; the current front-end is Phenom.

verification.pagination: Numbered pages with explicit result range and total; enumerate every page

job_watch_method.fallback: Use the KPMG Italy corporate careers page only as navigation; London must be checked on KPMG UK's separate inventory.

verification.pagination: Numbered pages/result ranges; enumerate all pages for the filtered set

verification.pagination: No pagination required when all published cards are rendered on the board; verify board total against card count

job_watch_method.fallback: Use individual BearingPoint Italy Teamtailor job pages for role confirmation. London, if required, should be checked on the relevant BearingPoint regional portal.

verification.pagination: Dynamic Phenom pagination/offsets

job_watch_method.primary: Use the Oliver Wyman-specific search inside Marsh McLennan Careers, filter each target location and exhaust all visible result pages/offsets.
job_watch_method.fallback: Confirm any discovered job on its official Marsh McLennan detail page; do not use the wider Marsh/Mercer inventory unless the brand is explicitly Oliver Wyman.

Brand filtering is essential because the parent platform hosts multiple Marsh McLennan businesses.

verification.pagination: SmartRecruiters limit/offset; exact totalFound reconciliation required

job_watch_method.fallback: Use the official Roland Berger All Jobs page and current SmartRecruiters job-detail pages if the structured endpoint is inaccessible in a run.

verification.pagination: Board pagination/results; enumerate until the number of unique roles equals the displayed total for the filtered scope

job_watch_method.fallback: Use Kearney's corporate careers page only to navigate back to the Yello board.

verification.pagination: Workday dynamic paging/load-more

job_watch_method.primary: Use the ProtivitiItalyCareers Workday board, filter by Milan/Rome and enumerate all displayed results before applying Job Watch exclusions.
job_watch_method.fallback: Use Protiviti Italy careers pages to confirm individual requisitions; London should be checked on the appropriate UK Protiviti inventory separately.

limitations: Workday rendering is JavaScript-heavy and no stable public feed was independently validated.
Italy and UK career inventories are not necessarily the same tenant/board.

verification.pagination: Dynamic/white-label job search; complete page count is not reliably exposed

job_watch_method.primary: Use Bain's Find a Role interface with office/location filters and follow only official Bain/Avature job links; treat the run as PARTIAL unless all result pages can be enumerated.
job_watch_method.fallback: Use careers.bain.com official job-detail/folder pages to confirm individual openings.

limitations: The public role finder is heavily dynamic and the underlying Avature inventory is not exposed as a stable enumerable endpoint to these tools.
Do not infer absence of a Milan/Rome/London role from a generic Bain careers page.

verification.pagination: Load-more/result-limit pagination with explicit counts and location facets

job_watch_method.primary: Use the official Amazon Jobs /en/search.json inventory. Discover the exact normalized_location value for Milan, Rome, Luxembourg and London, then exhaust every page and reconcile retrieved rows to the API hits count before any business-role or experience filtering.
job_watch_method.fallback: Use official Amazon Jobs search UI and official job-detail pages to reconcile requisition IDs; use external job boards only for discovery, never as the completeness source.

limitations: Target-city completeness can be certified only when API hit counts reconcile exactly for Milan, Rome, Luxembourg and London.
Amazon's 4-6 years experience bucket cannot by itself enforce a <=5-year rule; inspect Basic Qualifications and keep ambiguous no-numeric-minimum roles for review.

verification.pagination: Client-rendered result navigation/windowing; total count is visible but exhaustive traversal is not robustly exposed to this crawler

job_watch_method.primary: Use Google Careers Jobs results with exact location filters and enumerate every available result page/window; record the portal total before filtering by role family.
job_watch_method.fallback: Confirm discovered roles on official Google Careers job-detail pages and use web search only as discovery.

limitations: The portal exposes a total but the crawler does not reliably expose a deterministic final-page mechanism, so FULL is not assigned.

verification.pagination: Dynamic search; total/pagination are not reliably exposed and some crawler-rendered cards resolve as removed

job_watch_method.primary: Use Uber's official jobs search with Country/City/Team filters and verify each candidate job detail individually; do not mark the company VERIFIED unless the complete result set becomes enumerable in that run.
job_watch_method.fallback: Use official indexed Uber job-detail pages for discovery/confirmation only.

limitations: Inconsistent dynamic rendering makes the complete inventory impossible to prove with the available tools.
Some search cards were rendered as removed even while the search interface remained available.

ats.family: SmartRecruiters (shared DeliveryHero tenant) + Glovo custom front-end

verification.pagination: SmartRecruiters public Posting API uses limit/offset; Glovo custom front-end adds brand-specific presentation

job_watch_method.primary: Use Glovo's official careers inventory and cross-check against the DeliveryHero SmartRecruiters Posting API; paginate the parent feed completely, then retain only postings unambiguously identified as Glovo and target-location matches.
